description: Defines leaving groups for each reaction type to identify reacted motifs.
notes: Observable-based model: leaving_groups = substituents present in reactants but absent in products. Byproducts (H2O, HBr, etc.) are typically not shown in reaction SMILES and are not tracked.

reaction_pattern_types._comment: Reference only - not used in logic. All patterns reduce to: which substituents disappear?

coupling_substitution.description: Coupling or substitution reactions where leaving groups completely leave the scaffold. Observable: substituent gone in product.

condensation.description: Functional groups transform/combine. Part of group stays (e.g., -COOH → -CO-).
condensation.note: Cannot easily identify leaving group from motif alone

addition.description: Groups add across multiple bond. No leaving group from substrate.

cycloaddition.description: Two unsaturated systems combine to form a ring. Both substrates consumed entirely.

cyclization.description: Intramolecular ring closure where one substrate forms a new ring bond.

annulation.description: Ring construction that forms one or more new bonds, often from two partners.

electrophilic_aromatic_substitution.description: Electrophile replaces aromatic C-H while aromaticity is restored.

nucleophilic_aromatic_substitution.description: Nucleophile replaces a leaving group on an activated aromatic ring.

oxidation.description: Net increase in oxidation state of substrate motifs.

reduction.description: Net decrease in oxidation state of substrate motifs.

olefination.description: Formation of C=C bond from carbonyl or related precursors.

elimination.description: Small molecule eliminated (H2O, HX, etc.), often forming unsaturation.

Suzuki_miyaura.notes: Both halide/pseudohalide AND boron group are leaving groups

C_N_Coupling.notes: Halide leaves electrophile, amine N-H bond breaks (detected as -NH2 motif)

Chan_Lam_C_N_Coupling.notes: Boron leaves aryl, H leaves amine

C_O_Coupling.notes: Halide leaves electrophile, alcohol O-H bond breaks (detected as -OH motif)

C_S_Coupling.notes: Halide leaves electrophile, thiol S-H bond breaks (detected as -SH motif)

Alkyl_Nucleophilic_Substitution.notes: Alkyl halide/sulfonate substitution by N/O/S nucleophiles (SN2-like alkylation).

Sonogashira.notes: Halide leaves aryl, terminal H leaves alkyne

Heck.notes: Halide leaves aryl, vinylic H leaves alkene

Cyanation_coupling.notes: CN comes from reagent (CuCN, Zn(CN)2, etc.)

Amide_formation.notes: Carboxylic acid/chloride + amine -> amide. Both functional groups participate.

Acyl_Halides_formation.notes: Carboxylic acid conversion to acyl halide (acid chloride/bromide/iodide/fluoride).

Alkene_Hydrogenation.notes: No leaving groups - H2 adds across C=C to give saturated products.

Epoxidation.notes: O adds across C=C to form epoxide

Wacker_oxidation_terminal_alkene_to_keto.notes: Oxidative hydration of terminal alkenes to ketones under Pd/Cu catalysis.

Wacker_oxidation_internal_alkene_to_keto.notes: Oxidative hydration of internal alkenes to ketones under Pd/Cu catalysis.

Click_cuaac.notes: [3+2] Azide + alkyne cycloaddition - both substrates consumed entirely to form triazole

Diels_Alder.notes: [4+2] Diene + dienophile cycloaddition - both substrates consumed entirely

Oxidation_primary_alcohol_to_carboxylic_.notes: Primary alcohol oxidation to carboxylic acid.

Benzylic_CH_oxidation_to_carboxylic_acid.notes: Benzylic C-H deep oxidation to carboxylic acid.

Baeyer_villiger_oxidation.notes: Oxidative oxygen insertion into ketones to form esters/lactones.

Alkene_oxidative_cleavage_to_carbonyl.notes: Oxidative C=C cleavage to aldehyde/ketone fragments.

Alkene_oxidative_cleavage_to_carboxylic_.notes: Strong oxidative C=C cleavage to carboxylic acids.

Arylation_acidic_C_H.notes: Halide leaves aryl, acidic H leaves substrate

Minisci_alkylation.notes: H leaves heteroarene, COOH leaves as CO2 from radical precursor
